name: The Dark Mansion
source:
You will step into the shoes of Lady Isabelle Thornfield, a young aristocratic widow returning to her ancestral home after tragic events. What should have been a quiet retreat soon becomes a descent into supernatural secrets, forbidden desires, and the struggle between duty and temptation. 

[From [url=https://koralovelace.itch.io/the-dark-mansion]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演伊莎贝尔·桑菲尔德女士的角色，她是一位年轻的贵族寡妇，在经历了悲惨事件后回到了她的祖籍。原本应该是安静的隐居之地很快就陷入了超自然的秘密、禁忌的欲望以及责任与诱惑之间的斗争。

[来自[url=https://koralovelace.itch.io/the-dark-mansion]Itch.io[/url]]
